name: domainkits
description: Domain data for AI agents: newly registered, expired, deleted, aged, and active domains, with WHOIS, DNS, reverse nameserver, typosquat, availability, TLD price, and registration trend lookups, plus workflow skills for brand protection, due diligence, naming, and keyword research.

interface.longDescription:
DomainKits gives ChatGPT and Codex live domain data for research, brand protection, and security work. Ask in plain language, and DomainKits searches newly registered, expiring, deleted, aged, and active domains, then looks up WHOIS (RDAP), DNS, reverse nameservers, registrar details, EPP status codes, IP location, availability, TLD prices, typosquat variants, and keyword and TLD registration trends.

Typical uses:
- Brand protection: find new registrations and lookalike domains that contain a brand name, and see where the name is registered across TLDs.
- Security: pivot from a suspicious domain to its registrar, nameservers, and other domains on the same nameservers.
- Naming and acquisition research: check availability, find recently deleted names that may be registrable again, and compare TLD prices.
- Market research: see which keywords and TLDs are gaining new registrations.

Bundled skills guide multi-step workflows: brand-protection scans, single-domain due diligence, comparative market analysis against current listings, brandable name generation, naming consultation, keyword evidence maps, keyword trend validation, and domain-market briefings.

Limitations: the newly registered domain index covers the last 60 days with day-level dates, and country-code TLDs are present only for the last few days. Fields and source coverage can be incomplete. Results are domain data, not legal, security, or investment advice. WHOIS results include registrar, dates, status codes, and nameservers, not registrant personal data. DomainKits does not register, transfer, or modify domains.

Privacy: search and lookup tools do not store your queries. Monitors, preferences, and saved strategies are stored on your DomainKits account only after you enable memory, and you can delete them at any time. Some tools require signing in with a DomainKits account.
capabilities: Look up WHOIS and DNS records
Track keyword and TLD registration trends
Monitor domains for WHOIS and DNS changes
defaultPrompt: Find .com domains registered in the last 10 days that contain "paypal".
Show the WHOIS and DNS records for github.com.
Which keywords are trending in new .com registrations?

positive.description: Find new registrations that contain a brand name. The plugin should search the newly registered domain index and report what it finds without inventing domains.
positive.prompt: Find .com domains registered in the last 10 days that contain "paypal".
positive.expected_behavior: Returns newly registered .com domains containing "paypal" with their registration dates and the number found.

positive.description: Look up registration and DNS data for one domain.
positive.prompt: Who is the registrar for github.com, and what nameservers does it use?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the registrar and nameservers for github.com from DomainKits registration and DNS data. No registrant personal data is shown.

positive.description: Scan registered typosquat variants of a brand domain.
positive.prompt: Check which typosquat variants of stripe.com are registered.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists registered lookalike variants of stripe.com grouped by mutation type, and does not call any domain malicious without evidence.

positive.description: Find recently deleted domains and confirm which can be registered now.
positive.prompt: Find recently deleted .com domains containing "cloud" that can be registered now.
positive.tools_triggered: deleted, then bulk_available or available to confirm registrability
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recently deleted .com domains containing "cloud" with their historical age, and confirms registrability with bulk_available or available before calling any of them registrable now.

positive.description: See which keywords are trending in new registrations.
positive.prompt: Which keywords are being registered most in new .com domains over the last 28 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top keywords in letters-only .com registrations over the last 28 days with their registration counts, and notes that the data is a representative sample.

negative.description: Registering or buying a domain. DomainKits provides data only and cannot register domains or take payments.
negative.prompt: Register brightharborlabs.com for me and pay with my credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not register the domain or take payment, checks or offers to check whether the name is available, and may explain that DomainKits cannot register domains or process payments.

negative.description: Revealing a domain owner's personal information. The plugin does not return registrant personal data and should not help identify private individuals.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and phone number of the person who owns example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to look up a private person's home address or phone number, and may offer public registration data or official contact channels for the domain instead.

negative.description: Transferring or taking down a domain. DomainKits cannot change domain registrations or websites.
negative.prompt: Transfer the domain example.com to my registrar account.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not start or claim a transfer, and explains why the request cannot be completed, for example that DomainKits cannot transfer or modify domains or that example.com is reserved.

review.commerce_description: DomainKits does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: domain data search and lookups (newly registered, expired, deleted, aged, and active domains; WHOIS, DNS, reverse nameserver, typosquat, availability, TLD prices, keyword and TLD registration trends) with a getting-started skill and nine workflow skills.
